_comment: Inscriptions: Avarra words cut into equipment at an inscription table. A word changes how the item meets the world. Each word on an item works in one of four ways ('type'): passive (always on), activated (right click with the item; costs stamina), conditional (works by itself when its condition holds) or compositional (does nothing alone; it only works as part of a composition). Compositions are fixed pairs of words that together make one effect; they are checked first, in this order, and the words they use do nothing else. 'fits' lists the item classes a rule works on (items.json 'inscribe.class'). 'effect' names code in Core/Inscription that runs it; its numbers can never pass the limits under 'effects'. Word ids are the stable ids from lexicon.json. Mapping from the design brief: SONIC = word_sonic (Ulun), FORCE = word_push (Vuh, already learned in the echo ruin), FORTIFY = word_fortify (Tahr), RECLAIM = word_reclaim (Oshen), FRACTURE = word_fracture (Drai). 'tunings' change one item into another at the table, keeping its words and wear: the item must already carry 'needs_word', and the 'in' materials are used up. 'power_bonus' on resonant_mining lets the ringing tool break stone that many tiers harder than it could.

tunings.text: The quartz is set into the pick's channels. It rings at the pitch of the old builders' stone now, and a second channel has opened for another word.

words.text: Right click to make it ring. While it rings, it digs stone faster and a broken block shatters the stone joined to it.
Always on: it wears out half as fast.
When you rest by a fire or a Tether, it slowly mends.
Alone it does nothing. It waits for a word to push.
Alone it does nothing. It waits for a word that rings.

compositions.name: Resonant strike
compositions.text: Right click: the hammer rings and a shockwave throws back and hurts everything around you.

compositions.name: Self-mending
compositions.text: It mends by itself, all the time.

compositions.name: Seam splitting
compositions.text: Right click: it rings, and stone splits along its seams. It breaks stone one tier harder than the pick could, and whole veins come away at once.
